about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client for a skilled and detail-oriented Architect / Draughtsperson to join their team in Mellieħa, Malta. You will prepare architectural drawings, develop design concepts, produce technical documentation and support projects through every stage, from concept to construction.

Day to day, you will turn architectural concepts and sketches into accurate plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction drawings, amend them after design changes or client feedback, and help prepare planning applications and permit documentation. You will coordinate with architects, engineers and contractors and carry out site visits when needed to check progress and verify measurements.

This full-time, on-site role suits a motivated professional with strong AutoCAD skills and a real interest in architectural design and construction. Only candidates currently residing in Malta will be considered.
